items.label: Open ModPilot
items.description: Open the ModPilot chat: a natural-language mod copilot powered by Gemini.

items.label: Check this post for reposts
items.description: Run ModPilot repost detection against this post on demand.

items.label: Seed test posts (dev only)
items.description: Seed ~20 posts across all categories ModPilot can handle: reposts, spam, caps violations, low-effort, engagement bait, self-promo, inflammatory tone, untagged spoilers, drama.

items.label: Mop comments
items.description: Remove this comment and all child comments. This might take a few seconds to run.

items.label: Mop post comments
items.description: Remove all comments of this post. This might take a few seconds to run.

similarityThreshold.label: Repost similarity threshold (0-100)
similarityThreshold.helpText: Posts scoring at or above this percentage are flagged. 85 is a balanced default.

autoCommentEnabled.label: Auto-comment with link to the original
autoCommentEnabled.helpText: When on, the app replies under flagged posts with a link to what it matched.

autoReportEnabled.label: Auto-report flagged posts to modqueue
autoReportEnabled.helpText: When on, every flagged post is reported so it surfaces in your normal modqueue.

lookbackDays.label: Lookback window (days)
lookbackDays.helpText: How far back to compare against. Older fingerprints are pruned daily.
